article.story: Syracuse (5-5) at Boston College (4-6), Nov. 21 at 12 p.m. EST. Opening Line: Syracuse by 2.5. Against the spread: Syracuse 6-4, Boston College 5-5. How to watch: ACC Network Key stats Syracuse Offense Overall: 428.1 yards per game (28th in FBS) Passing: 273.7 yards per game (18th) Rushing: 154.4 yards per game (68th) Scoring: 29.8 points per game (52nd) Syracuse Defense Overall: 355.3 yards per game (65th in FBS) Passing: 218.2 yards per game (80th) Rushing: 137.1 yards per game (61st) Scoring: 26 points per game (85th) Boston College Offense Overall: 329.9 yards per game (121st in FBS) Passing: 172.1 yards per game (122nd) Rushing: 157.8 yards per game (64th) Scoring: 20.4 points per game (120th) Boston College Defense Overall: 359.5 yards per game (70th in FBS) Passing: 191 yards per game (37th) Rushing: 168.5 yards per game (99th) Scoring: 28.4 points per game (101st) Boston College is 110th in third down percentage, converting 34.9% of the time. Syracuse ranks 59th on defense, allowing its opponents at convert at 37.2%. Syracuse ranks 138th in the FBS with 83.9 penalty yards per game. Boston College ranks 135th in FBS in red zone offense, scoring on 67.7% of trips. Boston College ranks 80th in the FBS with an average time of possession of 29:40, compared to Syracuse's 17th-ranked average of 32:13. Team leaders Syracuse Passing: Steve Angeli, 1,721 yards, 10 TDs, 6 INTs, 56.5 completion percentage Rushing: Tylik Hill, 591 yards on 115 carries, 2 TDs Receiving: Umari Hatcher, 1,045 yards on 66 catches, 8 TDs Boston College Passing: Mason McKenzie, 1,667 yards, 10 TDs, 9 INTs, 56.0 completion percentage Rushing: McKenzie, 686 yards on 159 carries, 5 TDs Receiving: Javarius Green, 335 yards on 34 catches, 2 TDs Last game Syracuse won 34-31 over NC State on Nov. 14. Angeli led Syracuse with 272 yards on 27-of-42 passing (64.3%) for two touchdowns and no interceptions. Hill had 60 rushing yards on 15 carries and one touchdown. Calvin Russell III recorded 137 yards on 17 catches with one touchdown. Boston College was beaten by Notre Dame 41-7 on Nov. 14. McKenzie passed for 51 yards on 8-of-21 attempts (38.1%) with no touchdowns and one interception. Mekhi Dodd had 45 rushing yards on six carries. Bo MacCormack III had three receptions for 20 yards. He also had seven carries for 29 yards and one touchdown. Next game Syracuse hosts No. 3 Notre Dame on Nov. 28. Boston College plays at No. 5 Miami (FL) on Nov. 28.
